# [CS035] Insecure Cookie SameSite Policy (cookie-insecure-samesite)

A session cookie uses SameSite=None.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-1275](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1275.html) |
| **OWASP** | A07:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

SameSite=None sends the cookie with cross-site requests, which re-enables CSRF and cross-site leaks. Use Lax or Strict unless the cookie must work in third-party contexts.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: id, Secure: true, HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode})
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: id, Secure: true, HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode})
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [cookie-insecure-samesite]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    cookie-insecure-samesite: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore cookie-insecure-samesite -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** cookie-insecure-samesite
```
